claims.text: The official notice confirms the specific-angle fade adjustment and a fix for circumstances where its display was incorrect.

anchors.quote: Fixes an issue in Version 1.4 where the fading effect of the "Agent appears faded when viewed from specific angles" adjustment did not display correctly under certain circumstances.

claims.text: The official multi-issue notice apologized and offered 300 Polychrome for the notice as a whole.

anchors.quote: We sincerely apologize for the disruption these issues have caused to your gaming experience. As compensation, we will be sending you Polychrome ×300 via in-game mail.
anchors.locator: apology and compensation paragraph after four issue bullets

limitations: The notice does not say the fade adjustment was removed.
The 300 Polychrome cannot be attributed only to the fade issue.
The notice states no censorship motive.

claims.text: The article reports one public interpretation that paid or unlocked characters should remain fully viewable.

anchors.quote: 他们已经花钱购买解锁这些角色，但却不让全方位的欣赏角色。

frames.problemDefinition: The fade is defined as restricted access to a character already paid for or unlocked.
frames.causalAttribution: The visible game behavior is attributed to the publisher-side display rule.
frames.moralEvaluation: The quoted player presents the restriction as inconsistent with having obtained the character.

anchors.quote: 他们已经花钱购买解锁这些角色，但却不让全方位的欣赏角色。

limitations: The quoted frame is evidence that the interpretation appeared publicly, not that it was prevalent.
The article supplies no regional or population distribution.

claims.text: The official Version 3.1 benefits page states that the event 'Summer Waves Arrive' provides Lucy's swimsuit outfit 'Princess Holiday' for free.

anchors.quote: 参与活动「恰浪花逐夏而至」免费领取露西泳装「公主假日」
anchors.locator: official content API sContent, fourth benefit bullet

limitations: This official product-context fact does not imply any display defect, audience reaction, or future controversy.
No evidence indicates the outfit will exhibit a fade problem or generate controversy.
